descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S25 Card and delete flow match the source-of-truth prototype, in look and function

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Design and functionality match the final source-of-truth prototype. (TFA-92579 AC 1)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given The prototype file Q13 names, opened next to the local build

When Compare side by side: layout, field order, badge styles, the pop-up and the toast; and the card's functions: the status badge in each state (Not Yet Prepped / Pre-Rounded / Seen / Note Ready / Complete), the pending-task count, the 'New today' chip, and the status-coloured border per status

Then Look and function match the prototype

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Human side-by-side review against the named file; no oracle until Q13 names it

Where it ran: dev; test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: manual (not-testable)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
